d:
I really wanted to translate all the moans and stuff, but man, those blush lines. My inpaint spazzed out anytime I used it on the blush lines, meaning I had to go in and redraw them. However, as I use a mouse since drawing tablets are more than I can afford currently, at best their shaky, at worst for the love of god don't zoom in on them. It was especially bad when it combined a transparent textbox with the blush lines.

So, instead of doing the moans, I just translated the words. Most of the stuff I didn't translate was just "Ohs" and "Ahs" anyway, but my perfectionism really doesn't like me not doing them. Not much I can do with a mouse though.

Anyway, I finally downloaded Adobe Photoshop through...methods...and now there shouldn't be anymore blurred text like my previous translations and I have a lot more freedom of transforming the text and such without absolutely destroying the quality. I'm working on fixing a Kazakura machine translation that was uploaded on here like a year ago. Now for that I can translate all the moans and stuff, thankfully.

If you like this translation, cool. If you don't, understandable.
n: [Doujinshi] [GFRP] Yuka-chan wa Sensei no xx。| Yuka-Chan is Sensei's xx [English]
